summary: Feature 22 FPS Game (replacing Games Station) validated end-to-end. Backend: all 12 REST tests + 4 NEW WebSocket tests pass (including the previously untested kill/respawn + two-client flow + player_left broadcast + match-history persistence). Frontend: /features/fps-game lobby renders all 11 required testids, arena renders with WebGL canvas + HUD (HP=100, Kills:0, Deaths:0) + crosshair + feed showing 'You joined the room' + connection state 'Connected' + leave returns to lobby; sidebar shows 'FPS Game'; old route /features/games-station returns 404 (correct). Regression on adjacent features/gallery blocked by transient Cloudflare 429 during test run — retry recommended.

minor.issue: _load_admin_password() markdown parser is fragile — fails to extract password from `- Email: admin@realaicoach.app` style entries in test_credentials.md, forcing reliance on TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD env var. Falls back to '' and asserts. Not blocking (env var provided) but should parse markdown reliably.

action_items: OPTIONAL: harden password parsing in test_feature22_games_station.py so md-style credential lines don't require TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD env override.

OPTIONAL follow-up when CF 429 clears: verify /features gallery still shows 36 cards + Watch Videos + Travel Visa + Home dashboard load without errors (transient WAF blocked this leg of the regression test).
critical_code_review_comments: games_station.py: fps_rooms is single-process in-memory registry — documented limitation. If backend scales horizontally, WS gameplay will fragment per pod. Acceptable for MVP but flag before enterprise rollout.

handle_fps_ws: does not enforce per-user rate limit on 'hit' messages. Client-authoritative aim (as per source repo) — a hostile client could send hits faster than fire cadence. Server does validate target alive + target != self + HP clamp, so worst-case is fast kill-drain within room, not privilege escalation.
_record_match: writes a match doc per player-disconnect (not per match end). This is fine but produces one doc per join/leave; ensure this is expected for the match-history API contract.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on FPS Game surfaces tested (lobby+arena+sidebar+old-route-404); regression on adjacent routes deferred due to CF 429
